commands.minecraft_mcp.status.stopped: MCP server is not running (see config/minecraft_mcp.json and the logs)
config.minecraft_mcp.title: Minecraft MCP
config.minecraft_mcp.restart: Changes are applied the next time the game starts.
config.minecraft_mcp.server.enabled.tool: Turns the MCP endpoint on or off.
config.minecraft_mcp.server.host.tooltip: Keep 127.0.0.1 unless you also set an auth token: the server refuses to start on another address without one.
config.minecraft_mcp.server.authToken.to: Optional bearer token that clients must send. Stored in plain text. The MCP_TOKEN environment variable overrides it.
config.minecraft_mcp.server.gameThreadTi: Maximum time a tool waits for the game thread.
config.minecraft_mcp.commands.restricted: When on, run_command refuses the commands listed below, even behind /execute ... run. A guard rail against mistakes, not a sandbox.
config.minecraft_mcp.commands.denied.too: Root command names refused in restricted mode.
config.minecraft_mcp.client.disablePause: Keeps the game running when its window loses focus, so the AI can drive it in the background.
config.minecraft_mcp.client.screenshotMa: Wider screenshots are downscaled to save tokens.
